commentary: Market breadth is severely compromised with breadthScore at 36 and the systemic gate flagged WEAK following heavy distribution across the Nifty 50 (-1.75%) and Sensex (-1.77%). Under Stan Weinstein's framework, broad market indices are flashing late Stage 3 topping and distribution behavior as critical short-term moving averages break down. William O'Neil and Jesse Livermore underscored the vital discipline that three out of four stocks track the general market trend. In an adverse tape, breakout failure rates soar and institutional sponsorship wanes. Adhering to Minervini's progressive exposure rules requires cutting losses ruthlessly, elevating cash reserves, and restricting watchlists to elite relative strength candidates displaying accelerating earnings until a verified market follow-through day occurs.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box Discipline

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook Stage 2 structure holding firmly above rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA. Completed a constructive double bottom base with 1.15x volume expansion. RSI at 71 reflects powerful relative strength versus a deteriorating index, pressing resistance near 1048.30.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Exceptional CANSLIM acceleration driven by contract manufacturing and Xanthine leadership. Operating margins stand firm at ~22%. ROCE is 11.5% and ROE is 9.2%. Promoter holding is 39.7% with 12% pledged; ₹400Cr capex elevates leverage but expands CDMO capacity.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Thesis invalidates below the 963.13 stop (base low); immediate exit warranted if market-wide distribution derails high-beta momentum.

ABDL.technical: Constructing a double bottom neckline retest above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. MACD is positive above signal and zero. Strong intraday lower wick shows rejection of lows, but breakout volume needs institutional confirmation to clear 855.55 pivot.
ABDL.fundamental: Steady volume expansion in IMFL spirits driving Q2 revenue to ₹1,148 Cr (+15.9% YoY) and net profit to ₹85 Cr (+17.9% YoY). ROCE is solid at 18.4% and OPM holds at ~13.3%. Lacks the CANSLIM 25% EPS explosion.
ABDL.risk: Breakdown below the 798.53 swing support negates neckline base; execute Minervini loss cut immediately.

ABGSEC.technical: No Stage 2 momentum or equity base structure. Trades mechanically within sovereign yield bounds near 118 with low secondary liquidity. Moving average crossovers and volume spikes reflect passive index rebalancing rather than institutional accumulation.
ABGSEC.fundamental: Not verified. ABGSEC is an open-ended exchange-traded debt fund tracking the CRISIL Broad Based Gilt Index, investing purely in Government of India sovereign debt securities. Equity metrics such as sales, EPS, ROCE, and margins do not apply.
ABGSEC.risk: Instrument is a debt ETF outside equity growth mandates; carry risk and opportunity cost negate asymmetric SEPA returns.

AIROLAM.technical: Advancing within Stage 2 above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Established a double bottom support base with a 3-up sequence off dynamic EMA support. RSI at 54 shows constructive recovery, though volume remains thin given micro-cap liquidity.
AIROLAM.fundamental: Laminate producer showing top-line revival with Q2 sales jumping +30.4% YoY to ₹81.5 Cr and PAT rising +42.4% YoY to ₹3.8 Cr. ROCE is 10.2% and ROE is 7.9%. Promoter holding is stable at 53.5% unpledged. Modest microcap margins.
AIROLAM.risk: Failure below 103.64 structural swing low breaches the 50-DMA; illiquid order book demands strict stop adherence.

AJAXENGG.technical: Consolidating within 1.5% of its 635.63 pivot in an orderly Stage 2 structure above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. MACD is positive with volume at 1.56x 20-day average, signaling overhead supply absorption.
AJAXENGG.fundamental: Market leader in concrete equipment with zero debt, 23.9% ROCE, 17.8% ROE, and 80% promoter holding. Q2 PAT rose +30.3% YoY to ₹50.9 Cr, but sales grew only +9.5% YoY to ₹487 Cr, failing CANSLIM's 15% revenue requirement.
AJAXENGG.risk: A close below 594.18 invalidates the pivot base; sub-10% revenue expansion exposes the stock to valuation derating.

AJMERA.technical: Decisive Stage 2 breakout clearing a 20-session Darvas consolidation box on an extraordinary 28.87x volume expansion. Price cleanly above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with MACD confirming momentum. Stellar relative strength divergence against a falling market.
AJMERA.fundamental: Robust residential pre-sales drove Q2 revenue up +44.7% YoY to ₹317 Cr and net profit up +48.2% YoY to ₹48.5 Cr. OPM is strong at ~27%, ROCE is 14.3%, and promoters hold 68.6% with negligible 0.02% pledge.
AJMERA.risk: Thesis breaks down if price drops back below the 135.25 breakout pivot; cut losses quickly on false-breakout reversal.
